g.text: Train accuracy on sampled (on-policy) answers, centred 3-step mean. Every run drawn. Evidence counts rewarded samples in groups with reward variance, over earlier steps.

g.text: Evidence depends on accuracy itself, so overlap can't prove identical learning. cued_v1 used other choice and word rules, so those panels have 2 runs.
